rows.title: Fire both kilns on Sunday night

detail.label: Outcome
detail.body: Both kilns fire from Sunday 22:00, with Kiln A first.

detail.label: The call
detail.body: Night rates start at 22:00 and the studio is empty, so nothing waits on a person.

detail.label: Checked against
detail.body: The tariff sheet and the kiln logs from September.

detail.label: Outcome
detail.body: Porcelain fires to cone 6 only; cone 10 is stoneware.

detail.label: The call
detail.body: One firing schedule per clay body keeps the logs short.

detail.label: Checked against
detail.body: Eleven test tiles, all clean.

rows.title: Buy a second set of shelves

detail.label: Outcome
detail.body: Not settled: a second shelf set doubles a firing but costs about 400 euros.

detail.label: The call
detail.body: Waiting for the next order book before spending.

detail.label: Your answer
detail.body: Buy now, or wait for the November orders?

rows.title: Label tiles with a stamp, not a pen

detail.label: Outcome
detail.body: Stamps survive the glaze fire; pen marks burn off.

detail.label: The call
detail.body: Stamp the number into the wet tile.

detail.label: Checked against
detail.body: Three tiles lost their pen numbers in October.

detail.label: Outcome
detail.body: Dropped for now: the electric kilns cover the order book.

detail.label: The call
detail.body: Revisit when the wood-fired work grows past one firing a month.

detail.label: Outcome
detail.body: Lidded buckets, labelled with the date mixed.

detail.label: The call
detail.body: Open buckets skin over in a week and add lumps.

detail.label: Checked against
detail.body: The two skinned buckets from the last batch.

detail.label: Outcome
detail.body: Not settled: seconds sell well at markets but lower the price of firsts.

detail.label: The call
detail.body: Two options are costed on the sheet.

detail.label: Your answer
detail.body: Sell seconds only at the studio door?

rows.title: Wedge clay on the new bench

detail.label: Outcome
detail.body: The new bench is at wedging height and stays.

detail.label: The call
detail.body: Fewer air bubbles in the first throw.
